bibl.title: Caligantem nigra formidine lucum: Verg. georg. 4.468, la stele di Philae e un'annotazione degli Scholia Bernensia.
bibl.seg: Paola Gagliardi, Caligantem nigra formidine lucum: Verg. georg. 4.468, la stele di Philae e un'annotazione degli Scholia Bernensia.
bibl.note: The term formido, very elegant as used by Vergil, Georgics 4.468, is significant and might have been part of the poetic lexicon of Gallus, as it appears in the Philae stele [I. Philae II, 128].
